name: Twisted Carrion Revel
descriptionTemplate:
Deal [Damage:Arg1] {Pierce DMG}, increasing the Base DMG of {Twisted Carrion Revel} by 20% for this battle,
"24" switches between Depressed and Manic Personas. Trigger additional effects based on the current {Realm and Persona}.
lore:
"Tentacles, countless Tentacles are dragging me from the ground...
Doctor, is it hysteria...?"
The woman cried helplessly, deeply afraid. Across from her sat a long-haired doctor wearing glasses.
"No, it's not hysteria."
The doctor smiled, his eyes narrowing like a snake's.
"This is reality... the twisted reality of this world."
